name: Payroll
description: Thai payroll: pay profiles per employee (monthly salary or daily wage, bank name + last 4 digits only, social security, provident fund, tax allowances, recurring allowances and loans with balances, mid-year opening balances), CSV import of profiles and of monthly inputs (OT hours at 1/1.5/2/3, work days, unpaid leave, bonus), monthly runs PR-2569-10 draft → calculated → approved → paid with a pure calculation engine (SSO 5% with wage floor/ceiling, PND1 withholding by the annualised year-to-date method with bonus taxed at the marginal rate, pro-rata for joiners and leavers), printable Thai payslips, employee self-service payslips, bank transfer list, SSO 1-10 data, PND1 monthly summary, annual 50 Tawi certificates, all legal rates as settings, and a balanced accounting summary event when a run is paid.
